title: Abandon a merged member of a live release
when: An operator abandons merged work still listed in a created or executing deployment run.
need: Read the named run and remove the item with deployment-runs remove-item and a reason before retrying items cancel --abandon-merged. Removal remains audited and obeys its existing gates; finish or cancel the run if removal is unavailable. The refusal leaves the item and membership unchanged.
surface: items cancel help, lifecycle manual and merged_item_live_deployment_run refusal
